sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host New Mills on Saturday 22 August at 15:00, looking to bounce back after their midweek 3-2 defeat at Foley Meir. Both teams sit on 6 points with identical records, making this an intense fixture between two evenly-matched sides. Sandbach will be eager to secure their second home win of the season and maintain their position in the upper half of the table.
divisionWide: The division remains highly competitive with several clusters of form. Wolverhampton Casuals (9 pts, 3-0-0) continue their perfect start away at Wednesfield Community on Tuesday before hosting Eccleshall on Wednesday, while AFC Bridgnorth (6 pts, 2-0-0) travel to Wednesfield the same night—both unbeaten sides will be tested. Stafford Town and Eccleshall (6 pts each) face crucial fixtures: Stafford host Crewe on Saturday while Eccleshall visit Wolverhampton. Several mid-table teams including Brereton Social (6 pts) and Shawbury United (4 pts) play significant matches. At the bottom, Market Drayton Town (0 pts) remain pointless and face another challenge. The Edward Case Cup midweek action on 8 August has shuffled some momentum—Telford Town impressed with a 3-2 cup victory over Alsager, while Foley Meir and Shawbury both won their cup ties, suggesting form may shift heading into the league weekend.
